newsitem.title: USA: Centennial says probing reported results; fires chairman.
newsitem.headline: Centennial says probing reported results; fires chairman.

text.p: Centennial Technologies Inc., a producer of personal computer cards and a contract maker of computer parts, said Tuesday it was checking the accuracy of previously reported financial statements, and announced that its chairman and chief executive officer had been fired.
Preliminary information has raised significant questions as to whether reported results contained material misstatements, the company said.
Trading in Centennial's stock was halted on the New York Stock Exchange after it closed Monday at $16.375.
The Billerica, Mass.-based firm said it was focusing on the earnings it reported for its fiscal second quarter ended Dec. 31 and financial statements for prior periods.
The board has appointed a special committee comprised of four directors to oversee the inquiry, it said.
Centennial said Emanuel Pinez, chairman, chief executive and secretary, was fired.
The company also said James Murphy is being relieved of his duties as chief financial officer until further notice and is assisting the company in its inquiry.

John Shields, vice-chairman of the board of directors, will chair the special committee. The special committee has engaged independent legal counsel to assist with the investigation, the company said, and independent auditors are assisting with this effort.
The special committee will also start a search for a CEO and an interim CFO.
